mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse_returns ( return_id,outbound_id,order_id,order_line_id,warehouse_id,tracking_number,expected_quantity ) VALUES (#{returnId},#{outboundId},#{orderId},#{orderLineId},#{warehouseId},#{trackingNumber},#{expectedQuantity}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE return_id=return_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM warehouse_returns WHERE return_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE warehouse_returns SET received_quantity=#{quantity},status=#{status},received_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE return_id=#{id} AND status='WAITING_RECEIPT'
UPDATE warehouse_returns SET status=#{status},inspected_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE return_id=#{id} AND status='RECEIVED'

UPDATE warehouse_returns SET supplement_id=#{evidenceId},qualified_quantity=#{quantity}, supplement_note=#{note},supplement_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE return_id=#{id} AND supplement_id IS NULL AND status IN ('SHORT_RECEIVED','FAILED')
